label: Slow-to-rise and slow-to-fall
subgoals: Assign each line a slow-to-rise and a slow-to-fall fault
Assume the extra delay is large enough to miss capture on any path
Count transition faults as two per line including branches

label: Two-pattern tests
subgoals: Set the initial value on the line with the first vector
Launch the opposite value at speed with the second vector
Make the second vector a stuck-at test for the initial value

label: What the model misses
subgoals: Recognize gross delay as the model's core assumption
Prefer long paths to catch small-delay defects
Use path-delay or timing-aware tests for critical paths
